name: Smoothed Energy Guidance (SEG)
plain: Instead of removing self-attention, it blurs its queries. Blurring Q smooths the attention energy, and the difference from the normal pass is added as guidance. Blur sigma below 0 means flatten Q completely to its mean.
math:
σ_b≥0: Q' = gaussian_blur(reshape(Q), size⌈6σ_b⌉ odd, σ_b)
σ_b<0: Q' = mean of Q over space
x̂_s = M(x; c) with attn(Q',K,V)
G = w(x̂_c − x̂_s); x̂ = x̂_cfg + (rescaled G) (or SNF mode).

props.params: scale=3.0, blur_sigma=-1, unet_block=middle, unet_block_id=0, sigma_start, sigma_end, rescale, rescale_mode

label: from code
surprise: Default blur_sigma of −1 is not a mild blur: it collapses all queries to a single mean.
